FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Olaya Moldes Andres, Associate Professor in Marketing and Strategy at Cardiff Business School. She explains that, beyond the sales, the success of Black Friday may also be due to a desire by shoppers to "join the collective action. events.title: How American Thanksgiving took root — and evolved — in Liberia
events.description: The first settlers of Liberia were African Americans who brought along the holiday of Thanksgiving — which has evolved to reflect the history and identity of this new nation.

events.title: China investigates Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining

events.title: India's Modi government calls special sitting of parliament
events.description: The sitting of the Indian parliament comes after its monsoon session was adjourned sine die in August. Follow DW.

events.title: New Zealand election ends in hung parliament

events.title: At odds over the EU budget, European leaders cut summit short
events.description: Even before they met, it was clear the gap between European leaders' demands for the EU budget would make negotiations difficult. They ended a summit meeting early and aim to agree on EU funding in December. DW has more.

events.title: Gerard Depardieu to stand trial in France for rape and sexual assault

events.title: Guinea-Bissau junta delays presidential vote for 2 years
events.description: The decision came exactly one year after the military took power on November 26, 2025. The junta said the conditions were insufficient to hold presidential elections for now.

events.title: On farewell trip, Steinmeier calls for more investment in Africa
events.description: Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana, Kenya: On his last trip to Africa, outgoing German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier called on companies at home to be bolder and seize opportunities in Africa.

events.title: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe

events.title: EU-Indonesia trade deal opens new markets, but challenges remain
events.description: The agreement offers new export and investment opportunities for Jakarta and Brussels. But can Indonesia turn Europe's growing interest in its markets and critical minerals into sustainable gains at home?

events.title: Lyon held and Marseille pushed in mixed Europa League night for French clubs
events.description: There were mixed fortunes for the French clubs in Thursday's Europa League action, as Marseille saw off Levski Sofia (1-0) in the only win of the night. Lyon were held at home by Lillestrom of Norway, while Rennes fell to Dutch side Nijmegen.

events.title: Is Spain's snap election being rigged? Debunking viral claims
events.description: Ahead of Spain's snap election on Sunday, allegations of vote rigging - known in Spanish as "pucherazo" - are spreading widely on social media. From claims that undocumented migrants are being illegally registered to vote, to allegations that postal ballots and vote counts could be manipulated, internet users are accusing Pedro Sánchez's government of attempting to rig the election. But these claims misrepresent how Spain's electoral system works, as Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake.

events.title: Spain's De Cos chosen as next ECB president
events.description: European leaders have agreed to nominate the former head of the Bank of Spain as the next president of the European Central Bank. Pablo ​Hernandez ‌de ⁠Cos will replace the outgoing Christine Lagarde as the bank faces pressure to tackle high inflation, borrowing costs, and government debt. Also in the show - US regulators give SpaceX the green light to send satellites for data centers into space, and American households face higher costs for their Thanksgiving celebrations.

events.title: Marie-Antoinette’s porcelain ‘nipple bowl’ fetches record $3.1 million at Paris auction
events.description: A "jatte-teton", or nipple bowl, that once belonged to French Queen Marie-Antoinette fetched a record €2.9 million ($3.1 million) at Paris auction Thursday. The breast-shaped porcelain bowl was one of four such pieces which King Louis XVI once ordered for his queen's royal dairy creamery.

events.title: Airline suspends all flights - as carrier faces bankruptcy
events.description: Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights, with the company saying it could file for bankruptcy unless an urgent solution to its finances is found.
